payload.what: Sparse MLA Decode requires loading non-contiguous tokens from the KV cache:
payload.when: Sparse MLA Decode requires loading non-contiguous tokens from the KV cache:

implementation.snippet:
```
KV Cache [max_seq_len × head_dim]:
Token 0: [████████████████]
Token 1: [████████████████]  ← Not needed
Token 2: [████████████████]  ← Needed
Token 3: [████████████████]  ← Not needed
Token 4: [████████████████]  ← Needed
...

Traditional: Issue TMA copy per token → High TMA call overhead
TMA Gather: Collect multiple tokens in one instruction → Reduce TMA calls
```
